def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

from lib import upscale
def transform(grid):

add='''

from collections import Counter

def components(cells):
    """The 8-connected components of a set of (row, col) cells."""
    cells=set(cells); seen=set(); comps=[]
    for s in cells:
        if s in seen: continue
        stack=[s]; comp=[]; seen.add(s)
        while stack:
            r,c=stack.pop(); comp.append((r,c))
            for dr in (-1,0,1):
                for dc in (-1,0,1):
                    n=(r+dr,c+dc)
                    if n in cells and n not in seen: seen.add(n); stack.append(n)
        comps.append(comp)
    return comps

def bbox(grid, cells):
    """The bounding box of the cells as (top, left, height, width)."""
    r0=min(r for r,_ in cells); r1=max(r for r,_ in cells)
    c0=min(c for _,c in cells); c1=max(c for _,c in cells)
    return r0,c0,r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left+width] for row in grid[top:top+height]]

def nonbg_cells(grid, bg=None):
    """Positions of cells whose color differs from the most common color (background)."""
    if bg is None: bg=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg]

def stamp_template(grid):
    """Stamp the largest connected object's bounding box, centered, on every other non-background cell."""
    cells=nonbg_cells(grid)
    comp=max(components(cells),key=len)
    markers=[p for p in cells if p not in set(comp)]
    top,left,h,w=bbox(grid,comp)
    tm=crop(grid,top,left,h,w)
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0]); ar,ac=(h-1)//2,(w-1)//2
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in markers:
        for rr in range(h):
            for cc in range(w):
                R,C=r-ar+rr,c-ac+cc
                if 0<=R<H and 0<=C<W: out[R][C]=tm[rr][cc]
    return out
'''
